answer_text: Several design-build firms come up repeatedly for kitchen remodeling in the Boston area. answer_text: For a home addition in Wellesley, you will generally want a design-build firm or an experienced general contractor that handles permitting and structural work in-house. Firms that specifically market additions in Wellesley include New England Design and Construction (architectural design plus construction, Wellesley service page, NARI and PRISM award winner), Provost Companies (custom additions including kitchen expansions, first-floor primary suites and second-story additions), Millhawlk Design & Construction (integrated architects, engineers and builders handling permitting and code compliance), Refined Renovations (design-build with 20+ years, office at 184 Worcester St. in Wellesley), and Genesis Construction and Development (design-build additions, Tudor and Colonial specialties). Northeast Kitchen Remodel & Design Build, Boston Building Concepts (20+ years, licensed and insured) and Trust Contractors (serving Wellesley since 2003) also publish Wellesley addition pages. On HomeAdvisor and Yelp, Modern Habitat, LLC has a reviewed second-story addition in Wellesley, and BC Custom Builders (4.8, 47 reviews) is well rated. Get at least three bids, confirm Massachusetts CSL and HIC registration, and ask for recent addition references.
notes: Results are mostly contractor service-area landing pages plus HomeAdvisor/Yelp directories; few independent rankings. Out of the Woods did not appear.

answer_text: Cost: published estimates for a Waltham kitchen remodel vary by source. HomeBlue puts the range at $12,700 to $48,600, broken down as roughly $12,700-$18,500 for a small or basic job, $25,400-$37,000 for a mid-level remodel, and $32,400-$48,600 for a large or major one. Another local cost guide cites $14,500 to over $70,000, and a tiered breakdown runs $8,000-$18,000 for a refresh, $28,000-$55,000 for mid-tier stock cabinets, $58,000-$95,000 for semi-custom, and $110,000-$200,000+ for luxury with custom millwork and layout changes. Design-only fees typically run $600-$1,500, and projects take four to twelve weeks. Firms: design-build companies that actively serve Waltham include Harvey Remodeling (design-build, Waltham service page, Houzz awards, BBB A+), Bay State Remodeling (design-build with its Bay State Kitchen Gallery showroom at 145 Newton St., Waltham), Feinmann, Inc. (4.9 Houzz rating, 114 Waltham-area projects), New England Design & Construction (5.0, 58 Waltham-area projects), BB&R Design-Build and RemodelWerks LLC (both 4.9 on Houzz). Waltham-based kitchen remodelers include Watch City Kitchens (family-owned 70+ years, design through installation), HouseCraft LLC (250 Calvary St., since 2006), Three Sons, DLM Remodeling, Bertola Custom Homes and Green Bay Remodeling. Cost figures come from aggregator sites, so get itemized bids.
